license_required.quote: A certificate of certified public accountant shall be granted to persons of good moral character who have attained the age of eighteen years and meet the education, experience, and examination requirements of this Section and who make application to the board.

required.quote: An applicant for initial issuance of a certificate pursuant to the provisions of this Section shall show that he has completed one year of experience.

kind.value: accounting, attest, management advisory, financial advisory, tax, or consulting experience

exams.name: Uniform CPA Examination
exams.notes: Board may use AICPA Uniform CPA Examination and Advisory Grading Service; credit given for sections passed in other states
exams.quote: The board may make use of all or any part of the Uniform Certified Public Accountant Examination and Advisory Grading Service of the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants

available.quote: An applicant shall be given credit for any and all sections of the Uniform CPA examination passed in another state, provided that, at such time, he was a bona fide candidate of such state as determined by the board.
